additional_info.subject: 0411385 - ID0411121-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP / S4 170003534] Logs required & wakeup function (C1) CRM:00314000150
additional_info.body:
Good evening Jose,
I am reaching out regarding child case
ID0411385
regarding Wake-up & preconditioning functions on Sicharge D. Apologies for the delayed answer.
The Wake-up function (BCB toggle) is supported in the EcoG version v1.4.11, which is available as Hotfix.
However, we have currently two open issues, on which R&D is investigating, related to the Wake-up function:
Not possible to do a BCB Toggle on chargers without OCPP Backend
It seems that BCB Toggle needs physical interaction on the HMI
In regards of Preconditioning, could you please clarify which type of preconditioning are you referring to?
If you refer to preconditioning according to VDV261, it is not supported and it is not in the Sicharge D roadmap at the moment.
If you refer to preconditioning as a customized scenario, this has to be checked in detail and most likely through a
Vehicle Integration activity
.
Hope I provided you with an answer to your questions. Looking forward to hearing your feedback soon and if you have further questions.
Have a nice weekend!
